name: fir chlis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fir chlis is a figure of Scottish folklore. Known as the nimble man, he stood for the northern lights, called the aurora borealis. He appears in the folklore of Scotland.

okr.objective: fir chlis is the nimble man who personified the northern lights.
key_results: fir chlis appears in Scottish folklore.

The aurora borealis was his symbol.
